caveat: signals within a snapshot/day are correlated (co-firing strategies on the same trending day are especially correlated by construction); day-level holdout guards discovery but per-row t-stats here are optimistic versus a fully clustered-SE test. synergy_vs_best_alone < 0 means the combo is likely redundant (correlated proxies of the same underlying signal), not new information. Larger combo_size means far more tests are attempted against the same fixed history -- the Bonferroni correction below is harsher accordingly, by design.
